links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4o and oncologist responses to endometrial cancer patient questions
links.effect: Both ChatGPT and physician responses were similarly challenging to comprehend, requiring a high level of literacy; ChatGPT responses much longer (403.51 vs. 25.06 words).
links.quote: Readability scores indicated that both ChatGPT and physician responses were similarly challenging to comprehend, requiring a high level of literacy.

screen.reason: Prospective comparative study evaluating ChatGPT-4o's performance against oncologists on answering patient questions about endometrial cancer across primary and secondary care contexts.
